acl_policy.check: An extended or non-trivial POSIX ACL does not by itself make CHECK ERROR.
acl_policy.future_apply: For a future APPLY an extended ACL is a safety blocker only on a target whose MODE condition is TRUE and would require chmod go-w. On such a target with OWNER TRUE, MODE TRUE and an extended ACL the whole APPLY of this control must be blocked before the first mutation.

aggregation.dominance: Any discovery, classification, or revalidation ERROR dominates FAIL, PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE. FAIL on one target together with ERROR on another gives overall ERROR.
aggregation.empty_population: A fully and cleanly computed empty base population is NOT_APPLICABLE.
aggregation.not_found_not_reused: NOT_FOUND is not used for the empty-population case.

base_population.admission: A concrete executable regular file enters the population only when the rule is applicable in the supported subset, root-runas is proven, the exact Cmnd pathname is proven without filesystem guessing, and the final target resolves stably.
base_population.host_scope: Only a fully proven positive Host_List=ALL after alias expansion is supported. Any other hostname, network, netgroup, negation, or ambiguous host scope is ERROR.
base_population.incomplete_classification: Any incomplete or ambiguous classification is ERROR, never a silent exclusion.
base_population.invoker: Invoker identity does not narrow the population. The v1 ordinary-invoker restriction is removed.

command_pathname.alias: A Cmnd_Alias is evaluated after cvtsudoers expansion under the same rule; an expanded alias carrying arguments is ERROR.

excluded_forms.ALL: ALL names no concrete executable file of SRC-0008 and is skipped; the rights of system programs are checked by SRC-0012 (2.3.8). Only explicit absolute pathnames enter the population.
excluded_forms.sudoedit: sudoedit does not name an executable target of SRC-0008 and is excluded before the other command-form checks.

command_pathname.filesystem_is_not_an_oracle: Filesystem existence never determines the pathname boundary. Selecting an existing prefix is forbidden.
command_pathname.json_surface: cvtsudoers JSON merges executable pathname and arguments into one command string and unescapes escaped whitespace inside a pathname. The pathname boundary therefore cannot be proven from a command string that contains whitespace.
not_automated_yet: commands with arguments on the current JSON surface
pathnames containing escaped whitespace on the current JSON surface
command_pathname.ordinary_command: An ordinary concrete command string must be an absolute pathname with no whitespace; the whole string is the pathname.

compliance_semantics.error: ERROR when visudo validation fails, when visudo or cvtsudoers are unavailable or ambiguous, when applicability, runas, command form, pathname boundary, final target, or owner classification is not in the supported determinate subset, or when the visudo closure pathset, its bytes, or any other snapshot drifts during the check.
compliance_semantics.fail: FAIL when the determinate population contains at least one target whose owner is a regular user, or at least one target with the other-write bit set, and no ERROR occurred.
compliance_semantics.not_applicable: NOT_APPLICABLE when the population is fully and cleanly computed and empty.
compliance_semantics.pass: PASS when the base population is fully determinate and no target satisfies either conditional branch: every owner is root or a proven non-regular-user account, and no target carries the other-write bit.

final_target.downstream: Interpreter, frontend, and shebang are no longer an ERROR cause by themselves. No downstream script, interpreter, or argument-named file is inferred or checked.
error_conditions: identity drift between observation and revalidation
final_target.resolution: Only the target's own final regular executable file is resolved.
final_target.symlink: A symlink chain is allowed when the exact final target is unambiguous and stable.

cases.g+w and o+w: TRUE, and the prescribed go-w clears both bits

cvtsudoers.fallback: If /usr/bin/cvtsudoers does not exist, /usr/bin/cvtsudoers.ws is used (package sudo on Ubuntu 26.04, where sudo-rs is the active sudo) only when it is a regular file owned by root with no group/other write; otherwise ERROR cvtsudoers:untrusted-fallback (decision 24.09.2026). Its parser is that of package sudo, not of sudo-rs.

observation_tools.unstable_observation: Any tool failure, unparsable output, or drift of the visudo closure pathset or bytes between the two policy snapshots of one check is ERROR.

visudo.role: syntax validation and closure pathset of the active policy tree; the closure is the whole sudoers pathset observed

owner_condition.non_root: For a non-root UID the owner must exist unambiguously in passwd.
owner_condition.result: All applicable sources classifying the UID as REGULAR gives TRUE; all NON_REGULAR gives FALSE; mixed classification of one UID is ERROR.
source_rules: one optional source may be absent
an existing unreadable, invalid, or unusable source is ERROR
owner_condition.uid_zero: UID 0 gives FALSE: no ownership correction is required.

fail_closed: negation, netgroup, non-Unix or group-membership selector
root_runas.outside_population: A finite positive list of explicit non-root usernames or UIDs places the rule outside the base population.
root_runas.rationale: CHECK must not produce VALUE unless the exact root-runas subset is supported identically by the parser and by audit.
supported: absent runasusers means default root, but only when no unsupported runas_default is present
Runas_Alias expanded by cvtsudoers into one of the supported concrete selectors
a group part next to a supported user part, as in (ALL:ALL): the group part is not evaluated and admission is decided by the user part

source_interpretation.rejected_v1_reading: The v1 contract required st_uid == 0 and bits-clear 0022 simultaneously for every selected target. That conjunction is not the source requirement and is invalidated; it is not reused by any current control.
source_interpretation.scope: SRC-0008 / fstec-linux-2022 / 2.3.4 only. It does not replace the SRC-0004 policy review and does not add parent-directory requirements from SRC-0006.
source_interpretation.source_operations: The source states two independent conditional operations. Ownership is corrected only where the current owner is a regular user; chmod go-w is required only where the file is writable by others. CHECK represents them as read-only predicates and performs neither operation.

sudoers_pathset.no_authority: No reviewed-policy file is read; /etc/securelinux-policy is not a prerequisite of SRC-0008. The SRC-0004 review is a separate control.
sudoers_pathset.no_universal_policy: No universal approved users or commands are inferred from groups, donor defaults, environment, or VM state.
sudoers_pathset.source: The sudoers pathset is the closure that visudo -c reports for /etc/sudoers; its identities and bytes are observed and compared between the two policy snapshots of one check.
